tool_schemas.name: budget_summary
tool_schemas.description: Returns an aggregated snapshot of the specified local budget (by budget_id), optionally selecting the snapshot closest to or as of as_of_at. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if budget_id does not match the required format or as_of_at is not a valid RFC 3339 date-time, NOT_FOUND if the budget_id is not present or not accessible for the current connection, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to view this budget.

as_of_at.description: Optional timestamp to request the snapshot closest to (or as of) a given time.

tool_schemas.name: create_transaction
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new transaction in the specified budget and returns the created transaction record. Validates that budget_id is well-formed, transaction contains account_id, date, and amount_milliunits, cleared (if provided) is one of cleared|uncleared|reconciled, and that at least one of payee_id or payee_name is provided; otherwise raises VALIDATION_ERROR. Raises NOT_FOUND if the budget, account_id, payee_id, or category_id (when provided) does not exist in the budget, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot write to the budget, and CONFLICT if import_id is provided and matches an existing transaction such that the request would create a duplicate.

budget_id.description: Local budget id to create the transaction in.

account_id.description: YNAB account id the transaction belongs to.

amount_milliunits.description: Transaction amount in milliunits (negative for outflow, positive for inflow).

payee_id.description: YNAB payee id (provide this or payee_name).

payee_name.description: Payee name to use when payee_id is not provided.

category_id.description: YNAB category id for the transaction.

import_id.description: Optional import identifier to support idempotency/deduping.

tool_schemas.name: get_unapproved_transactions
tool_schemas.description: Lists unapproved transactions for the given budget and returns up to limit results plus a next cursor when more results are available; when cursor is omitted, the initial scan defaults to recent activity (approximately the last 3 days) and subsequent calls use the stored per-budget sync cursor to return only newly changed/unapproved items, optionally including deleted transactions when include_deleted is true. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if budget_id is malformed, limit is out of range, or cursor is not valid for this budget, NOT_FOUND if the budget_id does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to read transactions for the budget.

budget_id.description: Local budget id to fetch unapproved transactions for.

limit.description: Maximum number of transactions to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted transactions in results.

tool_schemas.name: list_budgets
tool_schemas.description: Lists locally mirrored budgets for the given connection_id, returning up to limit items sorted by sort/order with an opaque next cursor when additional pages exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id is malformed, limit is out of range, status/sort/order is not an allowed value, or cursor is invalid for this listing, and NOT_FOUND if the connection_id does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller is not authorized to access the requested connection.

connection_id.description: YNAB connection id to list budgets for.

status.description: Filter budgets by local budget status.

limit.description: Maximum number of budgets to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get_current_identity
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity for the current credential, including the resolved user_key, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption. Refuses requests with missing/invalid credentials (UNAUTHORIZED) and returns FORBIDDEN when the credential is valid but not entitled to use this service.

access_token.description: Bearer token or API key used to authenticate the request; required to resolve identity and entitlements.

tool_schemas.name: create_ynab_connection
tool_schemas.description: Creates (or re-authorizes) a YNAB connection for the calling user by storing the provided YNAB access token securely and validating it against YNAB. Returns the created connection record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when the token is missing/malformed, UNAUTHORIZED when the credential cannot be validated with YNAB, and CONFLICT when a connection already exists and allow_replace is false.

access_token.description: Bearer token or API key used to authenticate the request to this service.

ynab_access_token.description: YNAB personal access token to link; stored encrypted and used for upstream YNAB calls.

allow_replace.description: When true, replaces the existing stored YNAB token for this user_key if a connection already exists.

tool_schemas.name: update_ynab_connection
tool_schemas.description: Updates a YNAB connection's mutable fields and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions on status. Returns the updated connection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids or illegal status transitions, NOT_FOUND when the connection does not exist, and FORBIDDEN when the caller does not own the connection. When status is set to revoked, upstream YNAB calls are refused until reactivated.

access_token.description: Bearer token or API key used to authenticate the request.

status.description: Connection status; allowed transitions: active->(error|revoked), error->(active|revoked).

active_budget_id.description: Sets the active local budget for this connection; must belong to the same connection and not be removed.

tool_schemas.name: get_budget
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single locally mirrored budget by id and returns it if accessible to the current connection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if budget_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the budget does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the budget is not owned by the caller's connection.

access_token.description: Bearer token or API key used to authenticate the request.

tool_schemas.name: update_budget
tool_schemas.description: Updates a locally mirrored budget's mutable fields and/or drives allowed lifecycle transitions on status. Returns the updated budget. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids or illegal transitions, NOT_FOUND if the budget does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the budget is not owned by the caller's connection. Transitioning to removed clears it from active selection and may null the connection's active_budget_id.

access_token.description: Bearer token or API key used to authenticate the request.

status.description: Budget status; allowed transitions: active->(archived|removed), archived->(active|removed).

name.description: Optional local display name override for the mirrored budget.

tool_schemas.name: update_transaction
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing local transaction and, when applicable, propagates supported edits upstream to YNAB. Returns the updated transaction. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids, invalid cleared value, missing required fields on patch, or illegal lifecycle transitions; NOT_FOUND if the transaction does not exist; and FORBIDDEN if the transaction is not in a budget accessible to the caller. To delete a transaction, set status to deleted (or deleted=true where supported) which transitions active->deleted.

access_token.description: Bearer token or API key used to authenticate the request.

amount_milliunits.description: Updated amount in milliunits (negative outflow, positive inflow).

payee_id.description: Updated YNAB payee id; provide this or payee_name when changing payee.

payee_name.description: Updated payee name when payee_id is not provided.

status.description: Local lifecycle status; allowed transition: active->deleted.

deleted.description: Convenience flag to mark a transaction deleted; when true, sets status=deleted.

metadata.name: YNAB Budget Assistant
metadata.description: This backend stores a local mirror of a user's YNAB budgets plus a lightweight sync cursor that allows incremental retrieval of unapproved transactions.
